title: Cutting the cloth of EPR textiles within the EU
heroIntroduction: Textiles are the next waste stream to get extended producer responsibility across the EU. Here’s what the revised Waste Framework Directive asks of producers, and where each Member State stands.
excerpt: The revised EU Waste Framework Directive requires every Member State to set up EPR for textiles by April 2028. Here’s what it asks of producers, and where France, the Netherlands, Latvia, Italy, Spain, Germany and Sweden stand.
seoTitle: EU textiles EPR: the revised Waste Framework Directive, country by country
seoDescription: What the revised EU Waste Framework Directive means for textile producers, and where France, the Netherlands, Latvia, Italy, Spain, Germany and Sweden stand on textiles EPR.
